timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹310.71 Cr; net profit to shareholders ₹59.75 Cr.
Board approved draft Postal Ballot notice for MOA object clause amendments to align clauses with NBFC and ARC activities.
Authum Investment released its corporate presentation for May 2026 detailing its evolution into a diversified credit platform with ₹14,728 Cr net worth.
Mr. Amit Kumar Jha resigned as Chief Financial Officer of Authum Investment & Infrastructure Limited effective June 01, 2026.
Discharged resolution plan obligations for acquisition of Wind World (India) jointly with Inox Neo Energies, effective October 8, 2026.
Authum Investment announced NCLT Mumbai Bench approval for the resolution plan of A A Estates Private Limited on October 27, 2026.
